🆕 New posting (Published: October 21, 2026)

Coordinated Patrol Against Uncontrolled Development

Hanno City works with Saitama Prefecture and 25 other municipalities in the prefecture to conduct coordinated patrols aimed at preventing uncontrolled development around areas such as the Kan-Etsu Expressway interchanges.

For details on the definition of uncontrolled development and other information, please visit the Saitama Prefecture website.

Saitama Prefecture website: "Industrial Infrastructure Development Surrounding Areas – Uncontrolled Development Prevention Initiatives"

Patrol Period

November 2, 2026 (Monday) through November 30, 2026 (Monday)

Inquiries about the Coordinated Patrol Against Uncontrolled Development

Saitama Prefecture Industrial Infrastructure Measures Division

Phone: 048-830-5545

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/kankyokeizaibu/nogyoshinkoka/keikaku/14510.html
